text: 交易员正日益猜测墨西哥央行正在推动本币贬值，此前比索的强势曾对出口和旅游业构成威胁。 自9月初创下两年高点以来，墨西哥比索已暴跌近9%，在彭博追踪的31种主要货币中表现倒数第二。当月Banxico官员释放愿意降低借贷成本的信号后，比索的加速自由落体式下跌随之而来——上周该行出乎经济学家（此前普遍预期按兵不动）的意料，将利率下调了25个基点。
text_en: Traders are increasingly speculating that Mexico's central bank is pushing for currency depreciation, after the peso's strength had threatened exports and tourism. Since hitting a two-year high in early September, the Mexican peso has plunged nearly 9%, the second-worst performer among 31 major currencies tracked by Bloomberg. The peso's accelerated free fall came after Banxico officials signaled that month they were willing to lower borrowing costs - last week the bank cut rates by 25 basis points, surprising economists who had widely expected no change.
